name: Maska Chaska
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Refined Palm & Palmolein Oil, Sugar, Liquid Glucose, Raising Agents [503(ii), 341(ii), 500(ii) & 450(i)], Butter (1.2%), Black Salt, Milk Solids, Dehydrated Vegetable (Chives) (1%), Iodised Salt, Nature Identical Flavouring Substance, Dough Conditioner (223) And Improver [1101(i)].
